'$'''cat <<-'''NESTED'''
for ((i=0, i<2, i++)), do
 ( eval "echo NESTED-${depth}-\$i" ) &
done
wait
NESTED
' (1,522 us, 0.02%)
'@TRAP (EXIT): echo "EXIT $depth"\, trap "echo NESTED_EXIT $depth" EXIT :: @TRAP (RETURN): echo NESTED_RETURN 2' (55,973 us, 0.56%)

'$'''cat <<-'''EVAL_HEREDOC'''
{
 for i in {1..2}, do
 ( recursive_bg 2 ) &
 done
} | tee >(cat >&2) >/dev/null &
EVAL_HEREDOC
' (1,288 us, 0.01%)
